title: Tackling the Catch-22 Situation of Optimizing a Sensor and a Transporter System in a Whole-Cell Microbial Biosensor Design for an Anthropogenic Small Molecule.
authors: Shin, Sang-Min; Jha, Ramesh K; Dale, Taraka
one_liner_zh: 该文开发全细胞微生物传感器，涉及转录因子PcaR的改造以检测小分子，但核心是代谢工程与传感器设计，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Whole-cell biosensors provide a convenient detection tool for the high-throughput screening of genetically engineered biocatalytic activity. But establishing a biosensor for an anthropogenic molecule requires both a custom transporter and a transcription factor. This results in an unavoidable "Catch-22" situation in which transporter activity cannot be easily confirmed without a biosensor and a biosensor cannot be established without a functional transporter in a host organism. We overcame this type of circular problem while developing an adipic acid (ADA) sensor. First, leveraging an established cis,cis-muconic acid (ccMA) sensor, an annotated ccMA transporter MucK, which is expected to be broadly responsive to dicarboxylates, was stably expressed in the genome of Pseudomonas putida to function as a transporter for ADA, and then a PcaR transcription factor (endogenous to the strain and naturally induced by beta-ketoadipic acid, BKA) was diversified and selected to detect the ADA molecule. While MucK expression is otherwise very unstable in P. putida under strong promoter expression, our optimized mucK expression was functional for over 70 generations without loss of function, and we selected an ADA sensor that showed a specificity switch of over 35-fold from BKA at low concentrations (typically <0.1 mM of inducers). Our ADA and BKA biosensors show high sensitivity (low detection concentration <10 muM) and dynamic range ( approximately 50-fold) in an industrially relevant organism and will open new avenues for high throughput discovery and optimization of enzymes and metabolic pathways for the biomanufacture of these molecules. In particular, the novel ADA sensor will aid the discovery and evolution of efficient biocatalysts for the biological recycling of ADA from the degradation of nylon-6,6 waste.
abstract_zh: 全细胞生物传感器为基因工程生物催化活性的高通量筛选提供了一种便捷的检测工具。然而，为人为分子建立生物传感器需要同时具备定制转运蛋白和转录因子。这导致不可避免的“第22条军规”式困境：没有生物传感器，转运蛋白活性难以轻易确认；而在宿主生物中，没有功能性转运蛋白，生物传感器也无法建立。我们在开发己二酸（ADA）传感器时克服了这种循环性问题。首先，利用已建立的顺,顺-粘康酸（ccMA）传感器，一个注释为ccMA转运蛋白的MucK（预期对二羧酸具有广泛响应性）被稳定表达在恶臭假单胞菌（Pseudomonas putida）基因组中，以充当ADA的转运蛋白；随后，对PcaR转录因子（该菌株内源性的，且天然被β-酮己二酸（BKA）诱导）进行多样化改造和筛选，以检测ADA分子。尽管MucK在强启动子表达下在恶臭假单胞菌中通常非常不稳定，我们优化的mucK表达在超过70代中保持功能无丧失，并且我们筛选出一个ADA传感器，其在低浓度（通常<0.1 mM诱导物）下显示出对BKA超过35倍的特异性切换。我们的ADA和BKA生物传感器在工业相关生物中表现出高灵敏度（低检测浓度<10 μM）和宽动态范围（约50倍），这将为这些分子生物制造中酶和代谢途径的高通量发现与优化开辟新途径。特别是，新型ADA传感器将有助于发现和进化高效生物催化剂，用于从尼龙-6,6废弃物降解中生物回收ADA。
